references.text: David also uses imagery and parables to convey deeper truths, reflecting how Jesus taught.
Proverbs introduces the use of parables by wisdom to convey insight, paralleling Jesus' teaching method.
Isaiah is instructed to speak to the people in riddles and parables, which foreshadows and reflects Jesus' pedagogical style.
Micah uses parables to convey his message, aligning with how Jesus delivered his teachings.
This passage explains why Jesus used parables, providing context for his teaching method mentioned in verse 34.
Luke confirms that Jesus used parables to convey the mysteries of the kingdom of God, highlighting the significance of his teaching style.
